Zuciya ba ta samar da jini ba. Jini ana samarwa a cikin kasusuwa (bone marrow). Aikin zuciya shi ne ta tura jinin da aka riga aka samar zuwa ga dukkanin sassan jiki. Wannan kuskure ne na fahimta game da aikin zuciya.

Bari in yi nazari akan tambayar game da sauye-sauyen yanayin ruwa, musamman misalin takaitawa (condensation).

Takaitawa shine lokacin da tururi (gas) ya koma zuwa ruwa (liquid).

Bari in duba kowane zaɓi:

A. Faduwar dusar ƙanƙara a kan ruwan kogi - Wannan yana nuna haɗuwa ko narkewar ƙanƙara zuwa ruwa, ba takaitawa ba.

B. Canjin ƙanƙara zuwa tururi ta sanadiyar aikin Rana - Wannan sublimation ne (daga solid zuwa gas kai tsaye), ba takaitawa ba.

C. Sanyin ruwan teku da juyawarsa zuwa ƙanƙara - Wannan daskarewar ruwa ne (liquid zuwa solid), ba takaitawa ba.

D. Jikewar duwatsu da ke fuskantar tururin geyser - Lokacin da tururi (mai zafi) ya taɓa dutse (mai sanyi), tururi yana takaitawa ya zama ruwa a kan dutsen. Wannan misali ne na takaitawa.

D

Bari in duba manufar malamin: fahimta yanayin canzawa da yanayin gama gari na kimiyya a fannin na'urorin bugun zuciya.

Bari in tantance kowane zaɓi:

A. Ƙirƙiri samfurin na'urar sarrafa bugun zuciya - Wannan yana nuna aiki mai hannu da ƙirƙira, amma idan ana bin tsari da aka riga aka ayyana kuma aka inganta, ɗalibai ba za su fahimci yanayin canzawa ba, kawai za su bi umarni.

B. Yi bincike a kan juyin halittar na'urorin bugun zuciya sannan ka tsara takardar bayanai - Wannan yana nuna bincike kan yadda na'urorin suka canza a kan lokaci, wanda ke kai tsaye ga fahimtar yanayin canzawa da ci gaban kimiyya.

C. Haɓaka faifai na bayani kan sabbin ci gaba - Wannan yana nuna bayani kan sabbin abubuwa, wanda ke dangane da yanayin canzawa.

D. Tsara jadawalin lokaci da masana kimiyya - Wannan yana nuna tarihi da gudummawar masana, wanda ke nuna yanayin canzawa da ci gaban kimiyya.

Tambayar tana neman wanda **ya kauce** daga manufar. Zaɓi A yana ba da tsari da aka riga aka kafa ba tare da bincike kan canzawa ba.

**A**

Tambayar tana neman gano wane ra'ayi ne ya kamata ɗaliban su sani don fahimtar kumburi a matsayin wani ɓangare na rigakafin halitta (innate immunity).

Bari mu duba zaɓuɓɓukan:

A. Makirofajis suna gabatar da antigens ga T-limfosaitis - Wannan na rigakafi na musamman (adaptive immunity) ne, ba na halitta ba

B. Nirofils na yi fagosaitis ga nau'o'i daban-daban na kwayoyin cuta masu hadari - Wannan na rigakafi na halitta ne. Neutrophils suna ɗaya daga cikin farkon masu amsa a cikin kumburi kuma suna ɓangare na tsarin rigakafi na halitta

C. Kwayoyin T lymphocytes waɗanda suke maƙasudin wani takamaiman antijen suna ninka kansu - Wannan na rigakafi na musamman ne, ba na halitta ba

D. B lymphocytes suna rikiɗa zama kwayoyin plasma waɗanda ke fitar da antibodies - Wannan ma na rigakafi na musamman ne, ba na halitta ba

Kumburi shine ɓangare na rigakafin halitta wanda ke haɗa da neutrophils, macrophages, da sauran kwayoyin da ke amsa da sauri ga cutarwa ba tare da buƙatar tantancewa na musamman ba.

**B**

Bari in yi nazari kan wannan tambaya.

Manufar ita ce ɗalibai su yanke hukunci game da **alaƙar da ke tsakanin aikin tsarin narkar da abinci da buƙatun abinci mai gina jiki na ƙwayoyin halitta**.

Wannan yana nufin ɗalibai sun fahimci yadda enzymes (lipases, amylase, pepsin) ke narkar da manyan kwayoyin abinci (lipids, carbohydrates, sunadarai) zuwa ƙananan sassa waɗanda ƙwayoyin halitta za su iya amfani da su.

Bari in duba zaɓuɓɓuka:

A. Ƙaddamar da hasashe - Wannan yana nuna matakin farko na bincike, ba tantancewa ba
B. Shirya gwaji - Wannan yana nuna aiwatar da gwaji, ba tantancewa ba
C. Bincika ma'aunin gwaji - Wannan yana nuna nazarin sakamakon gwaji kawai
D. Bincika zane game da canjin sukarin jini bayan cin abinci - Wannan yana nuna yadda jikin ke amfani da sakamakon narkar da abinci (carbohydrates zuwa glucose), wanda ke nuna **alaƙar** tsakanin narkar da abinci da buƙatun ƙwayoyin halitta

Zaɓi D yana fi dacewa domin yana buƙatar ɗalibai su **yanke hukunci** game da alaƙar tsakanin tsarin narkar da abinci da amfanin ƙwayoyin halitta.

Manufar tana mai da hankali kan:
1. Halittu masu rai sun kunshi kwayoyin halitta (cells)
2. Waɗannan kwayoyin halitta an tsara su cikin matakai: kyallen jiki (tissues) → gabobi (organs) → tsarin jiki (systems)

Bari in duba kowane zaɓi:

A. Kwatanta kyallen jiki na salula na tsare-tsare daban-daban - Wannan yana magana ne kawai akan kyallen jiki da tsare-tsare, ba ya nuna cikakken fahimtar tsarin daga sel zuwa kyallen jiki zuwa gabobi zuwa tsarin jiki.

B. Fahimtar cewa kowace ƙwayar halitta tana fitowa daga wata ƙwayar halitta - Wannan yana magana ne akan haifuwar sel, ba tsarin halittu ba.

C. Kafa alaƙa tsakanin matakai daban-daban na tsarin halittu na jikin dabbobi da mutane - Wannan yana nuna fahimtar yadda ake tsara sel zuwa kyallen jiki zuwa gabobi zuwa tsarin jiki, wanda shine ainihin manufar.

D. Danganta kasancewa da yawan tsarin sel da ayyukan sel - Wannan yana mai da hankali ne akan tsarin sel da ayyukansu, ba tsarin gabaɗaya ba.

C

Don koyo mai ci gaba, mafi kyau shine:
- Fara da tarihi da juyin halitta (Aiki 3) - fahimtar yadda ra'ayin ya samo asali
- Gina samfuran (Aiki 4) - yin aiki da hannu don ƙarfafa fahimta

- Warware matsaloli (Aiki 2) - aiwatar da ilimin da aka samu

Looking at this question, Marcial's students believe that keeping the fire high will make the water hotter and cook the pasta faster. This is a misconception - water boils at a constant temperature (100°C at standard pressure), and increasing the heat beyond boiling point doesn't make it hotter, just makes it boil more vigorously.

To challenge this misconception, students need to discover that:
1. Water temperature stops increasing once it reaches boiling point
2. More heat doesn't mean higher temperature after boiling begins

Let me evaluate each option:

A. Investigating how boiling point changes under different environmental conditions - This is about external factors, not about what happens when you increase heat intensity.

B. Measuring time for 200ml of water to boil at different fire intensities - This only measures time to reach boiling, not what happens to temperature after boiling.

C. Presenting a method to study the difference in boiling temperature as a function of the amount of water heated - This is about water quantity, not heat intensity.

D. Heating water in a beaker until it boils, increasing the fire intensity, and measuring temperature every 30 minutes for 4 minutes - This directly tests whether increasing heat after boiling increases temperature, which directly challenges their misconception.

Option D allows students to observe that even when they increase the fire intensity after water is boiling, the temperature remains constant at boiling point.

D

Idan malami yana so ya bayyana wa ɗalibansa manufar haɗin kai na farko, yana nufin misali inda duka biyun halittu ke samun amfani daga dangantakarsu.

A. Tsuntsun Takala - Tsuntsaye suna samun abinci (kwari), kwari suna samun wurin zama. Duka biyu suna amfana. ✓

B. Dabbobi masu taunar gyro - Dabbobin suna samun abinci mai narkewa, bacteria suna samun wurin zama da abinci. Duka biyu suna amfana. ✓

C. Furen orchid - Orchid yana samun haske, ruwa, da ma'adanai, amma itacen ba ya samun komai. Wannan ba haɗin kai na farko ba ne (mutualism ba ne).

D. Kwayoyin cuta na Rhizobium - Kwayoyin cuta suna samun abubuwan gina jiki, tsire-tsire suna samun nitrogen. Duka biyu suna amfana. ✓

Amma tambayar tana neman misali ɗaya ne kawai. Misalai A, B, da D duk suna nuna haɗin kai na farko (mutualism). Misali C ba ya nuna haɗin kai na farko saboda itacen ba ya samun amfani.

Misali mafi bayyananne kuma mafi sauƙi don bayyanawa shine:

**D**

Manufar koyo ita ce: tantance ko ɗalibai sun gane abubuwan da ke sarrafa aikin sarrafa abinci na shuka (photosynthesis).

A cikin gwajin:
- Shukoki biyu (A da B) a wuri rufaffe
- Shuka A tana samun haske kore
- Shuka B tana samun haske shuɗi
- Duka suna samun ruwa iri ɗaya
- Tambaya: Wacce za ta fi girma?

Abubuwan muhimman da ke buƙatar photosynthesis:
1. Haske (amma ba duk launukan haske ba)
2. Ruwa
3. CO2
4. Chlorophyll (wanda yake ɗaukar launukan haske amma ba kore ba - yana haskaka kore)

Bari in duba amsoshi:

A. Yana magana ne kawai akan kuzarin photons - ba cikakken fahimtar photosynthesis ba

B. Yana magana akan chlorophyll yana ɗaukar shuɗi fiye da kore - wannan daidai ne! Chlorophyll yana ɗaukar launukan shuɗi da ja, amma yana haskaka kore

C. Yana nuna fahimtar cewa a wuri rufaffe, CO2 na iya ƙaranci - wannan muhimmin batu ne na photosynthesis

D. Yana magana ne kawai akan ruwa da stomata - ba cikakken hangen nesa ba

Amsar da ta fi nuna cikakken fahimtar photosynthesis ita ce **C** - domin tana nuna fahimtar cewa photosynthesis na buƙatar CO2, kuma a wuri rufaffe wannan zai iya zama matsala.

Tambayar tana buƙatar ɗalibi ya bayyana yadda hana GnRH zai shafi zagayowar kwai - wato ya bayyana sarrafawar hormones na hypothalamic (GnRH) akan zagayowar kwai.

Manufar ita ce ɗalibai su haɓaka ikon **gano abubuwan canzawa (variables) na wani bincike**.

- Variable mai zaman kansa (independent variable) - abin da ake canzawa

**C. Tsara Tsarin Nazari** - Wannan game da nazari ne (literature review), ba game da gano variables na bincike ba kai tsaye

**D. Gina samfurai** - Wannan game da ginin samfuri ne na tsarin sinadarai, ba game da gano variables na bincike ba

Looking at this question, the teacher wants students to understand how laws are established through studying relationships between physical variables, specifically in the context of Ohm's Law.

Let me analyze each option:

A. Students draw a graph of electric current vs. voltage for a good conductor, considering resistance as constant - This shows a relationship but doesn't involve students discovering it themselves through investigation.

B. Students create a graph from a table that records current intensity in a conductor for different voltages, then interpret it - This involves students actively working with data to discover the relationship between voltage and current, which is the essence of Ohm's Law (V=IR). They are discovering the law through investigation.

C. Students calculate resistance of different devices given measured voltage and current values - This is applying an already known formula, not discovering the relationship.

D. Students verify if manufacturer-reported resistance matches their measurements - This is verification, not discovery of the relationship.

The question asks which activity is appropriate for understanding "how laws are established through studying relationships between physical variables." Option B best fits this because students are actively discovering the relationship by creating and interpreting graphs from experimental data.

B

Looking at this question, I need to determine what activities students can do based on the historical text about the development of the steam engine from the 17th century through Watt's improvements.

Let me analyze each option:

A. "Bayyana aikin injin tururi da Watt ya ƙirƙira" (Explain the work/function of the steam engine that Watt invented) - The text mentions Watt's improvements but doesn't provide detailed technical information about how his engine actually works.

B. "Yi nazari mai zurfi a kan tsare-tsaren kimiyya..." (Conduct in-depth study on scientific designs, seeking their benefits and limitations in explaining natural phenomena) - This is too advanced and specific; the text is more historical than deeply scientific.

C. "Samar da misalai, wakilci, ko kwatance..." (Provide examples, representations, or analogies that would allow them to relate Physics concepts to everyday understanding) - The text doesn't provide enough technical physics content for this.

D. "Bayanin yadda ake la'akari da tsari mai ƙarfi da juyin halitta na gina ilimi, wanda kuma ci gabansa yana da alaƙa da yanayin zamantakewa da tarihi" (Explanation of how to consider the dynamic and evolutionary process of building knowledge, whose progress is also related to social and historical context) - This fits perfectly. The text shows the evolution of steam engine technology over time (Torricelli, von Guericke, Papin, Savery, Newcomen, Watt) and explicitly connects it to social context (mining needs, industrial revolution, spread to other countries).

D

Bari in yi nazari a hankali kan wannan tambaya game da koyar da Kimiyyar Polymers.

Tambayar tana neman jerin koyarwa daga **fadi zuwa ga mai takaituwa** (from general to specific/simple to complex).

Bari in duba kowane zaɓi:

**A.** Yana farawa da monomers (abubuwa masu sauƙi) → yadda ake samuwar polymers → misalan polymers
- Wannan yana tafiya daga ƙanana zuwa babba (monomers zuwa polymers)

**B.** Yana farawa da misalan polymers na yau da kullum → yadda ake samuwar polymers → menene monomer
- Wannan yana farawa da abin da ɗalibai suka sani (misalai na yau da kullum) zuwa bayani na kimiyya

**C.** Yana farawa da misalan polymers na yau da kullum → gano abubuwan da suke samar da su → bayyana yadda ake samuwa

**D.** Yana farawa da halayen kemikal → sannan ɗalibai su gano misalai
- Wannan yana farawa da abubuwa masu rikitarwa

Daga **fadi zuwa ga mai takaituwa** yana nufin farawa da:
- Abubuwan da suka fi kusa da ɗalibai (misalan yau da kullum)
- Zuwa ga bayani na kimiyya (polymers, monomers, halayen kemikal)

Zaɓi **B** yana farawa da misalan da ɗalibai ke gani a yau da kullum (fadi/general), sannan yana tafiya zuwa bayani na kimiyya (mai takaituwa/specific).
